name: expectation error
description: A twinge of negativity coming from a perception that an expectation was found to be incorrect. It's a brief mild sadness about being wrong, separate from the implications of being wrong.
perceptions: In order to live in the world, I need to understand it.
This perception conflicting with my expectation suggests that I may not understand this part correctly.
results: An expectation failing is just the first spark of what may be an avalanche of sensations. If you were wrong about predicting and something good happened, you may not care about being wrong. If you were wrong and something bad happened, you'll be doubly sad.
examples: The voting didn't go the way you'd predicted.

commentaries.quote: The proactive approach to a mistake is to acknowledge it instantly, correct and learn from it.
People need to be wrong as fast as they can.
Allow yourself to go and do it wrong. Don’t expect to always get it right. It will prevent you from doing anything.
We all can be wrong, some more often than others.
